scope: Qualitative review of free generations against fixed human captions; not a systematic semantic benchmark.

training_errors.observation: Omits hit from prepares to hit a baseball.
Replaces catch the frisbee with a baseball.

validation.observation: All eight generations describe an unrelated scene relative to the reference, with wrong objects or unsupported details. Outputs largely reproduce training-caption phrases.
validation.reversed_roles: Not separately established by this review.

interpretation: Successful tiny-set memorization and image dependence on training examples. Held-out captioning is poor; do not infer semantic generalization. The training-only pilot vocabulary maps 27.2% of validation word/punctuation tokens to UNK.
next_step: Declare a larger training-only tokenizer pool, freeze a vocabulary across nested subsets, and train a 1k-image pilot with a larger fixed image-disjoint validation set. Preserve reserved test IDs.
